description: ALTER VIEW ... ADD / DROP ROW ACCESS POLICY: a row access policy attached to a VIEW filters the view's OUTPUT rows exactly as one attached to a table filters scans, with the SYSADMIN and ACCOUNTADMIN bypass included, and the attachment survives a database CLONE. The policy name may be SCHEMA-QUALIFIED, and it resolves from the view's attachment rather than from the session's current schema. Dropping the policy restores full visibility. Converted 1:1 from security/ViewRowAccessPolicyTest (now retired). Four of its five tests carried an Assumptions.assumeFalse(isLiveSnowflake()) because the Java switched roles through engine.getSecurityManager().getSessionContext() and read the attachment through engine.getCatalog(), which under SF_LIVE still address the EMBEDDED engine while the SQL runs on Snowflake. The converted tests use plain USE ROLE and TABLE(INFORMATION_SCHEMA.POLICY_REFERENCES(REF_ENTITY_NAME => ..., REF_ENTITY_DOMAIN => 'VIEW')), both of which address whichever backend is running - so the skips are GONE and all five claims now hold on every transport.

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, region VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 'EU'), (2, 'US'), (3, 'EU')
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW orders_view AS SELECT id, region FROM orders
CREATE OR REPLACE ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only AS (r VARCHAR) RETURNS BOOLEAN -> r = 'EU'
ALTER VIEW orders_view ADD ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only ON (region)
SELECT POLICY_NAME, POLICY_KIND FROM TABLE(INFORMATION_SCHEMA.POLICY_REFERENCES(REF_ENTITY_NAME => 'orders_view', REF_ENTITY_DOMAIN => 'VIEW'))
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, region VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 'EU'), (2, 'US'), (3, 'EU')
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW orders_view AS SELECT id, region FROM orders
CREATE OR REPLACE ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only AS (r VARCHAR) RETURNS BOOLEAN -> CURRENT_ROLE() = 'SYSADMIN' OR r = 'EU'
ALTER VIEW orders_view ADD ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only ON (region)
USE ROLE SYSADMIN
SELECT id FROM orders_view ORDER BY id
USE ROLE PUBLIC
SELECT id FROM orders_view ORDER BY id
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, region VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 'EU'), (2, 'US'), (3, 'EU')
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW orders_view AS SELECT id, region FROM orders
CREATE OR REPLACE ROW ACCESS POLICY none_visible AS (r VARCHAR) RETURNS BOOLEAN -> FALSE
ALTER VIEW orders_view ADD ROW ACCESS POLICY none_visible ON (region)
USE ROLE PUBLIC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_view
USE ROLE SYSADMIN
ALTER VIEW orders_view DROP ROW ACCESS POLICY none_visible
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(INFORMATION_SCHEMA.POLICY_REFERENCES(REF_ENTITY_NAME => 'orders_view', REF_ENTITY_DOMAIN => 'VIEW'))
USE ROLE PUBLIC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders_view
